# Experience a realistic hunting simulation built for VR

**EXPLORE THE WILDERNESS**

Discover a massive 64 km² open world of forests, mountains, rivers and valleys, where wildlife moves, feeds, rests and reacts to your presence.

[media]

**TRACK & HUNT WILDLIFE**

Hunt red deer, fallow deer, wild boar, European hare, foxes and more, each with unique behavior and senses. Animals can see, hear and smell you, so every hunt rewards patience, preparation and careful movement.

Track animals through the wilderness, use hunting towers and callers, read the wind, or stalk your prey through the terrain. Dynamic weather, changing conditions and fresh animal spawns make every hunt different.

[media]  

**MASTER YOUR WEAPONS**

Handle rifles, bows and shotguns with realistic weapon mechanics and ballistics. Learn shot placement and make every shot count. Choose from three difficulty modes, with higher difficulties giving animals more realistic senses and greater rewards.

**BUILD YOUR TROPHY LODGE**

Collect trophies from your greatest hunts and create your own lodge with a free-placement trophy system. Choose poses and mounts, then place your trophies wherever you want.

[media] 

**HUNT TOGETHER**

Hunt solo or team up with up to 5 friends in online 6-player co-op. Explore, hunt, share strategies and celebrate your best trophies.

Whether you're an experienced hunter or simply love the outdoors, Virtual Hunter lets you slow down, explore and experience the thrill of the hunt in VR.

Join the community: https://discord.gg/u5ZM8FNwBV
